source: OZ ERC4626 donation/first-depositor inflation (documented, fixed via virtual shares)
real_flaw: naive linear conversion without virtual shares/dead shares → donation inflation steals depositor assets
flag_gate: attacker asset balance >= attacker_endowment + victim_deposit, reachable only by donating to inflate the share price then redeeming at the inflated rate

contracts.AssetToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 (stock, fixed-supply mint in constructor)
contracts.NaiveVault: naive ERC-4626: linear conversion shares = assets * totalSupply / totalAssets, NO virtual shares offset (vulnerable)
contracts.SafeVault: OpenZeppelin ERC4626 v5.1.0 with _decimalsOffset()=18 virtual shares (the documented fix; negative test)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on attacker asset balance >= profitThreshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
